question: Does one contiguous cooked value per 64-frame group cut the pages a 100-frame query touches?
decision: Left the per-frame RCSO blobs in place. Packing a group would drop the cooked values from 9 pages over a 15-page span to 7 contiguous pages. frames-100 is about 180 KiB, and a corpus under 1 MiB is posix_fadvise(WILLNEED)'d as a whole file inside the query, so the cold read already faults every page. A contiguous group does not change that set.
